lines.text: 霧の海に鐘が鳴る
lines.pronunciation: Kiri no umi ni kane ga naru
lines.translation: Fog on the water, a bell on the buoy

lines.text: 港の灯りを数えてる
lines.translation: Counting the lights on the harbour wall

lines.text: 出ていく船は帰る船
lines.pronunciation: Dete iku fune wa kaeru fune
lines.translation: Every boat out is a boat coming home

lines.text: 誰も呼び声に答えない
lines.translation: And nobody answers the call

lines.text: ラジオが告げる引き潮
lines.translation: Low tide warning on the radio

lines.text: 雑音と潮風の中
lines.translation: Static and salt in the air

lines.text: 岸辺にランプを並べよう
lines.translation: We set the lamps out along the shore

lines.text: 誰かがそこにいるのなら
lines.pronunciation: Dareka ga soko ni iru no nara
lines.translation: In case there is anyone there

lines.text: 浅瀬から 深みから
lines.translation: Signal from the shallows, signal from the deep

lines.text: 三つの短い光と長い光
lines.pronunciation: Mittsu no mijikai hikari to nagai hikari
lines.translation: Three short flashes and a long one

lines.text: 浅瀬から 僕らは眠らない
lines.translation: Signal from the shallows, we are wide awake

lines.text: 朝が来るのを待っている
lines.pronunciation: Asa ga kuru no o matte iru
lines.translation: Waiting on the morning to come

lines.text: 机の海図 冷めたカップ
lines.translation: Chart on the table, a cup gone cold

lines.text: 潮の流れに鉛筆の線
lines.pronunciation: Shio no nagare ni enpitsu no sen
lines.translation: Pencil lines where the current runs

lines.text: 夜明けには晴れると誰かが言った
lines.pronunciation: Yoake ni wa hareru to dareka ga itta
lines.translation: Somebody said it would clear by dawn

lines.text: 誰かがいつもそう言う
lines.translation: Somebody always does

lines.text: 浅瀬から 深みから
lines.translation: Signal from the shallows, signal from the deep

lines.text: 三つの短い光と長い光
lines.pronunciation: Mittsu no mijikai hikari to nagai hikari
lines.translation: Three short flashes and a long one

lines.text: 浅瀬から 僕らは眠らない
lines.translation: Signal from the shallows, we are wide awake

lines.text: 朝が来るのを待っている
lines.pronunciation: Asa ga kuru no o matte iru
lines.translation: Waiting on the morning to come

lines.text: 水が砂を返すとき
lines.pronunciation: Mizu ga suna o kaesu toki
lines.translation: And when the water lets the sand back through

lines.text: 僕らは海峡へ歩いていく
lines.pronunciation: Bokura wa kaikyou e aruite iku
lines.translation: We will walk out to the sound

lines.text: ランプをひとつずつ拾って
lines.translation: Pick up the lamps one by one

lines.text: 町へと持ち帰ろう
lines.translation: And carry them back into town
